Craft

Systems thinking, amplified by AI

Two practices that shape how I work: building foundations that scale, and using AI to move faster without losing the human touch.

01Design Systems

Design systems at scale

I build design systems from the ground up, starting with foundational tokens and atomic components and growing them into a complete, reusable library. The result is a single source of truth that keeps products consistent, speeds up delivery and makes design and development collaboration seamless. I also use AI to enhance the system itself, speeding up the creation of new components and variants so the library keeps evolving while staying consistent.
